steps.u: Replace the hand-rolled debounce in three of our Vue components with a composable. Same timing.

steps.r:
SearchBox.vue:21: clearTimeout(this.t); this.t = setTimeout(() => this.emitQuery(), 300)

steps.a: All three components use useDebounced with their original delays (300, 300, 500 ms), and the 31 component tests pass. As a side effect the timer is now cleared when a component unmounts, which the old code did not do, so a pending update can no longer fire after the component is gone.

reference.summary: Replaced three hand-rolled debounce timers in Vue components with one useDebounced composable, keeping the 300, 300 and 500 ms delays; 31 component tests pass. One small behaviour change: the pending timer is now cleared on unmount.
